title: Mechanical inbuf_clear goto audit
description: Write a coccinelle script or structured grep that enumerates every goto and early-return in crypto2dev_fd.c that occurs after the session mutex is acquired and key/IKM material may be in state->inbuf, and verify each path passes through inbuf_clear before returning. The static audit found 3 confirmed bypass paths (ioctl_key_generate error path, 7 ioctl_do_kdf pre-lock exits, ioctl_init copy_from_user early return on op.key). This task closes the question of whether there are additional paths. Acceptance: mechanical enumeration produces a complete list; each path is either confirmed to call inbuf_clear or is filed as a new bug.
close_reason: audit_inbuf_clear.py written and verified: 25 functions analyzed, 0 unclassified bypasses, 5 BYPASS exits all known WOLFKM-con.18, 5 INTENTIONAL exits documented. No new bugs found.
